subject: general
question: Amongst six friends A, B, C, D, E and F, each has a different height. B is taller than only two other friends. C is shorter than only one friend. E is shorter than B but taller than F. A is shorter than D. Who is the second shortest among all the friends?
solution:
Given: Amongst six friends A, B, C, D, E and F, each has a different height.

B is taller than only two other friends.

 
• _ > _ > _ B > _> _

C is shorter than only one friend.

 
• _ > C > _ B > _> _

E is shorter than B but taller than F.

 
• _ > C > _ B > E > F

A is shorter than D.

 
• D > C > A > B > **E** > F

Thus, **E **is the second shortest among all the friends.

Hence, the correct answer is** "Option 1".**
